info.name: Amazon S3 Control Access Control Storage Lens API
Amazon S3 List Storage Lens Configurations

params.name: nextToken
params.description: A pagination token for the next page of results.

items.docs: Gets a list of Amazon S3 Storage Lens configurations. To use this action, you must have permission to perform the s3:ListStorageLensConfigurations action.

info.name: Amazon S3 Get Storage Lens Configuration

params.name: storagelensid
params.description: The ID of the Amazon S3 Storage Lens configuration.

items.docs: Gets the Amazon S3 Storage Lens configuration. To use this action, you must have permission to perform the s3:GetStorageLensConfiguration action.

info.name: Amazon S3 Put Storage Lens Configuration

params.name: storagelensid
params.description: The ID of the Amazon S3 Storage Lens configuration.

items.docs: Puts an Amazon S3 Storage Lens configuration. To use this action, you must have permission to perform the s3:PutStorageLensConfiguration action.

info.name: Amazon S3 Delete Storage Lens Configuration

params.name: storagelensid
params.description: The ID of the Storage Lens configuration to delete.

items.docs: Deletes the Amazon S3 Storage Lens configuration. To use this action, you must have permission to perform the s3:DeleteStorageLensConfiguration action.
